title: DEFINE step 3 PR 8: rcf define validate folds in the PR 8 finding set
description: src/cli/validate.js runs `collectDefineValidateFindings(tree)` after the Code Node resolution pass and the companions check, folds the returned entries into the `errors` array it already exits on (exit 3), and reports them in the same `--json` envelope. The clean-output notice is suppressed when any PR 8 finding fires. The HELP text and the OPTION_SPEC are unchanged (the findings are the shipped surface).
